distractors: Able to reason a problem through step by step, holding several moving parts in mind at once without losing the thread.
Formally notified of something in writing, so that a record exists showing the message was sent and received.

Sceptical of a claim until somebody puts hard evidence in front of you, and willing to keep saying so while the rest of the room has already moved on. It reports a standing disposition towards proof rather than a state of having noticed anything in particular.

Considerate of how other people are feeling and adjusting what you say to fit it, so that a hard message lands without doing damage nobody needed. It is care aimed at the person in front of you rather than attention paid to a fact.

In agreement with a stated position, to the point of putting your name next to it in front of people who will hold you to it later. It reports where you finally landed on the question, not what you had in view while the question was being decided.
